scope: Independent read-only notebook persistence helper review. No app source edits. Native UI changes excluded.

executedChecks.name: Distinct unused IDs preserve identical content on initial and repeated import
Same-ID conflicts from distinct root IDs preserve independent content-identical copies
Nested intermediate-ID collision retains distinct root origins and is repeat-idempotent
Legacy same-content/different-origin envelopes retain both roots and daily steps
Legacy edits preserve refreshed daily steps and unknown metadata
Tombstone import preserves tombstone/daily steps and stores live source copy once
Null/missing core defaults compare identically without losing unknown metadata
Page validation rejects invalid created values, reserved IDs, day, steps, tombstone, source marker

nativeReadOnlyChecks.name: save current legacy steps survive stale draft steps
nativeReadOnlyChecks.evidence: save merges current legacy notes envelope and skips key steps when copying page value.

nativeReadOnlyChecks.name: unknown page fields survive save and import conflicts
nativeReadOnlyChecks.evidence: save begins with current.value; overlays provided fields. content retains unrecognized fields. imported copies retain incoming raw dictionary.

nativeReadOnlyChecks.name: stale save/deletion guards compare origin plus unknown-field content but ignore daily steps
nativeReadOnlyChecks.evidence: save/delete require sourceID equality and recursive JSON equal; content excludes identity, steps, pageDeleted and source marker.

nativeReadOnlyChecks.name: distinct identical IDs, nested import origin, bool vs number equality
nativeReadOnlyChecks.evidence: retainImported uses direct same ID+origin+content before collision; only collision branch searches same root origin+content. Native selfTest exercises these cases.

nativeReadOnlyChecks.name: created/steps/reserved-ID/source-marker schema aligned
nativeReadOnlyChecks.evidence: Native rejects extra steps/pageDeleted, reserved IDs; created calls nativeTime (finite, nonboolean, <=8.64e15); source marker is nonempty <=200 UTF16 units, matching Web.

resolvedFindings: Previously reproduced loss of distinct same-content pages resolved in executed Node fixtures.
Previously identified native page schema omissions now guarded in source.
Remaining Web legacy envelope origin omission resolved and independently regression-tested.
limits: Swift compiler unavailable in this Linux environment. Native validation/behavior was inspected statically; macOS native self-tests and simulator CI remain required.
This is persistence correctness verification, not a claim of original-app UI or feature parity.
